lbl.Il Digital Twin è uno strumento per: The Digital Twin is a tool for learning, studying and understanding the city. It does not replace official documents. It is a bit like a library: it tells you what exists, who produced it and where you can consult it.

lbl.Sono le scale colore scientifiche di: These are Fabio Crameri’s scientific colour maps: “perceptually uniform” colour ramps, where equal changes in the data correspond to equal visual changes. They read well even with colour vision deficiency and in black-and-white print, unlike rainbows such as “jet”, which create false bands and distort the values.
lbl.Sono usate qui per colorare i layer: They are used here to colour layers by attribute (sequential, diverging and categorical). Mapshaper includes them since version 0.7.75: 12 sequential scales (batlow, batlowW, acton, bamako, bilbao, davos, devon, lajolla, lapaz, oslo, tokyo, turku), 5 diverging (bam, broc, cork, roma, vik) and 1 categorical (batlowS).

lbl.Sul vostro dispositivo restano solo: Only your light or dark theme choice, the app’s offline cache (service worker) and, for those who use them, the layers loaded from your own computer or from a service you specified (IndexedDB) stay on your device. None of this is sent to us.

scheda.disclaimer: Disclaimer: the Digital Twin is a tool for learning, studying and understanding the city. It does not replace official documents. Cadastre, zoning plan and constraints are purely informational here and have no legal value. For a land-registry extract or a certificate of planning use, contact SISTER or the competent offices. Population data for individual buildings are also sample-based estimates and should be read as indications, not exact counts.
